notes: REF-BM-02: collects title/description/favicon (og + fallback) but never extracts a preview image (no og:image); no preview_image column. REF-BM-04: edits title/description/tags/readLater only — url is disabled/immutable in edit and there is no note field. REF-BM-10: dialog offers existing labels as a checkbox picker with case-insensitive reuse, but no autocomplete/typeahead on tag entry (no datalist). REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/site/url/labels via LIKE but no note field exists to search. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax parsing; '#article' is a literal LIKE that won't match stored label names. REF-BM-15: search term is a single LIKE pattern; no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling; quotes are treated literally. REF-BM-20: bulk supports add-label, mark read-later, and delete only — no remove-tags, mark-read, or archive bulk actions. REF-BM-21: bulk acts on explicitly checked ids only; no select-all/apply-to-whole-filter capability. REF-BM-22: list is fixed to created_at DESC; no sort key/control or sort param. REF-BM-23: no note/markdown field or rendering. REF-BM-24: no HTML snapshot or PDF handling. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (default sort/displayed items/font size) anywhere.
